scenario.question:
so i had this betta, finn, for like three and a half years. got him as a impulse buy from petco when i was in college, put him in this little half gallon bowl with some fake plants and a couple rocks, no filter no heater, just changed the water every week or so and fed him flakes. he seemed fine, swam around, did his little flare thing at the glass when i walked by, ate whenever i fed him. he died last month, just found him floating one morning, nothing dramatic, he was old for a betta i think.

anyway i was scrolling reddit last night kind of randomly and fell into this fishkeeping subreddit and people were posting these massive planted tanks for their bettas, like 10 gallons with filtration and heaters and driftwood, saying anything under 5 gallons is basically not enough space and that bettas actually need warm stable water and can get stressed or sick in small unheated bowls. and i just sat there feeling sick to my stomach honestly. like i had no idea, i just assumed since the pet store sold him in a tiny cup that a small bowl was normal and fine, thats literally what the display setup looked like in the store too.

im replaying the last few years in my head, like was he uncomfortable that whole time and i just didnt know, did i basically keep him in a cramped little glass the entire time thinking i was doing right by him because he seemed active. my roommate at the time even joked about how bare the bowl was and i brushed it off cause i figured fish dont need much. now i keep thinking about the moments he seemed sluggish or hid behind the plant and wondering if that ment something was actually wrong and i missed it becasue i didnt know what to look for.

i dont even know what im trying to figure out right now, i think im just still stuck on it. my partner thinks im overthinking a fish but it doesnt feel like overthinking to me, it feels like i messed something up for years without realizing.
